sloka: ततो भग्नप्रहरणौ मुष्टिभ्यां तौ समीयतुः।तेजोबलसमाविष्टौ दीप्ताविव हुताशनौ ।। ६.९८.२६ ।।
transliteration: tato bhagnapraharaṇau muṣṭibhyāṁ tau samīyatuḥ।tejobalasamāviṣṭau dīptāviva hutāśanau ।। 6.98.26 ।।

translations.english: Then, energetic Sugriva picked from the ground a frightening steel club encrusted with gold on all sides.
